                "location_start": "Crypts - Guardian Chamber",
                "location_start_id": "LOC_CRYPTS_GUARDIAN_CHAMBER_42074B",
                "location_start_label": "Crypts - Guardian Chamber",

                  "obsidian pedestal",
                  "pulsing red orb",
                  "boss trigger glyphs",
                  "cold stone floor"

                "transition_in_text": "Artie approaches the obsidian pedestal with a mix of fear and greed.",

                  "massive ribcage",
                  "glowing blue eyes",
                  "minimum damage readout",
                  "bone golem fist"

                "characters": [

                "location_end": "Crypts - Guardian Chamber",
                "location_end_id": "LOC_CRYPTS_GUARDIAN_CHAMBER_42074B",
                "location_end_label": "Crypts - Guardian Chamber",
                "location_start": "Crypts - Guardian Chamber",
                "location_start_id": "LOC_CRYPTS_GUARDIAN_CHAMBER_42074B",
                "location_start_label": "Crypts - Guardian Chamber",
                "outcome": "The boss battle begins with Artie at a massive disadvantage.",
                "scene_id": 9,
                "seam_resolution": "inline_bridge",
                "seam_score": 0,
                "summary": "The Floor Guardian, a Bone Golem, emerges, and Artie realizes he forgot to check its 'Minimum Damage' stat.",

                  "massive ribcage",
                  "glowing blue eyes",
                  "minimum damage readout",
                  "bone golem fist"
                ],
                "transition_in_text": "The Bone Golem fully forms, its massive shadow engulfing Artie.",
